<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?import javafx.scene.control.*?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.*?> <?import javafx.geometry.Insets?>
<BorderPane xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml" fx:controller="org.example.controller.ListProductsController" stylesheets="@../../css/style_front.css">
<top> <HBox alignment="CENTER_LEFT" spacing="20" styleClass="hero-top" prefHeight="90"> <!-- BRAND LOGO (Pulse) --> <VBox alignment="CENTER_LEFT" spacing="-2"> <Label text="PULSE" styleClass="brand-name"/> <Label text="e-sport arena" styleClass="brand-small"/> </VBox>
<Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS" />
<!-- MAIN TOPBAR NAVIGATION --> <HBox spacing="10" alignment="CENTER" styleClass="topbar"> <Button text="Accueil" styleClass="topbar-item" onAction="#goToHome"/> <Button text="Tournois" styleClass="topbar-item" onAction="#goToTournaments"/> <Button text="Jeux" styleClass="topbar-item" onAction="#goToGames"/> <Button text="Matchs" styleClass="topbar-item" onAction="#goToMatches"/> <Button text="Boutique" styleClass="topbar-item, topbar-item-active" onAction="#resetFilters"/> <Button text="Equipe" styleClass="topbar-item" onAction="#goToTeams"/> </HBox>
<Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS" />
<!-- AUTH & ACCOUNT --> <HBox spacing="12" alignment="CENTER_RIGHT"> <Button text="ADMIN" onAction="#goToAdmin" styleClass="btn-admin"/> <Separator orientation="VERTICAL" prefHeight="20" style="-fx-opacity: 0.1;"/> <Button text="Panier (0)" onAction="#goToCart" styleClass="btn-ghost"/> <Button text="SIGN IN" styleClass="btn-signin"/> </HBox> </HBox> </top>
<center> <ScrollPane fitToWidth="true" styleClass="scroll-pane"> <content> <VBox spacing="40"> <padding> <Insets top="50" right="40" bottom="50" left="40"/> </padding>
<!-- HERO MINI SECTION --> <VBox spacing="8" alignment="CENTER"> <Label text="BOUTIQUE" styleClass="section-label" style="-fx-font-size: 9;"/> <Label text="Boutique" styleClass="hero-title" style="-fx-font-size: 28;"/> <Label text="Catalogue des produits vendus par les equipes." styleClass="label-muted" style="-fx-font-size: 12;"/> </VBox>
<!-- FILTERS ROW (Web inspired) --> <HBox alignment="CENTER" spacing="12" styleClass="card" style="-fx-padding: 12 15; -fx-background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); -fx-border-color: rgba(40,255,138,0.15); -fx-border-width: 1;"> <TextField fx:id="searchField" promptText="Rechercher un produit..." onKeyReleased="#filterProducts" prefWidth="220" style="-fx-font-size: 11; -fx-padding: 8 12; -fx-text-fill: white; -fx-prompt-text-fill: rgba(200,200,200,0.6); -fx-background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); -fx-border-color: rgba(40,255,138,0.2); -fx-border-radius: 6;"/>
<ComboBox fx:id="teamFilter" promptText="Toutes les equipes" prefWidth="180" style="-fx-font-size: 11; -fx-padding: 8 12; -fx-background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); -fx-border-color: rgba(40,255,138,0.2); -fx-border-radius: 6;"/>
<HBox spacing="4" alignment="CENTER_LEFT"> <TextField promptText="Min" prefWidth="70" style="-fx-font-size: 10; -fx-padding: 6 8; -fx-text-fill: white; -fx-prompt-text-fill: rgba(200,200,200,0.6); -fx-background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); -fx-border-color: rgba(40,255,138,0.2); -fx-border-radius: 6;"/> <Label text="−" styleClass="label-muted" style="-fx-font-size: 12;"/> <TextField promptText="Max" prefWidth="70" style="-fx-font-size: 10; -fx-padding: 6 8; -fx-text-fill: white; -fx-prompt-text-fill: rgba(200,200,200,0.6); -fx-background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); -fx-border-color: rgba(40,255,138,0.2); -fx-border-radius: 6;"/> </HBox>
<CheckBox text="En stock" styleClass="label-muted" style="-fx-font-size: 11; -fx-text-fill: rgba(200,200,200,0.9);"/>
<Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/>
<Button text="Filtrer" styleClass="btn-signin" onAction="#filterProducts" style="-fx-padding: 8 16; -fx-font-size: 11; -fx-font-weight: 700;"/> <Button text="Reset" styleClass="btn-ghost" onAction="#resetFilters" style="-fx-padding: 8 16; -fx-font-size: 11; -fx-font-weight: 700;"/> </HBox>
<!-- PRODUCT GRID --> <FlowPane fx:id="productGrid" styleClass="cards-grid" alignment="TOP_CENTER" /> </VBox> </content> </ScrollPane> </center>
</BorderPane>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd"> <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
<groupId>org.example</groupId> <artifactId>PiDeb</artifactId> <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
<properties> <maven.compiler.source>21</maven.compiler.source> <maven.compiler.target>21</maven.compiler.target> <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding> <javafx.version>21.0.2</javafx.version> </properties>
<dependencies> <!-- JavaFX Controls --> <dependency> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-controls</artifactId> <version>${javafx.version}</version> </dependency>
<!-- JavaFX FXML --> <dependency> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-fxml</artifactId> <version>${javafx.version}</version> </dependency>
<!-- JavaFX Graphics --> <dependency> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-graphics</artifactId> <version>${javafx.version}</version> </dependency>
<!-- MySQL JDBC Driver --> <dependency> <groupId>mysql</groupId> <artifactId>mysql-connector-java</artifactId> <version>8.0.33</version> </dependency>
<!-- JUnit 5 --> <dependency> <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId> <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId> <version>5.10.1</version> <scope>test</scope> </dependency>
<dependency> <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId> <artifactId>lombok</artifactId> <version>1.18.44</version> <scope>provided</scope> </dependency>
</dependencies>
<build> <plugins> <!-- JavaFX Maven Plugin --> <plugin> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>0.0.8</version> <configuration> <mainClass>org.example.Main</mainClass> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- Maven Compiler Plugin --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.11.0</version> <configuration> <source>21</source> <target>21</target> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- Maven Surefire Plugin pour tests --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.1.2</version> </plugin> </plugins> </build>
</project>
